title: fleet-dashboard Helm values
description: Chart-owned validation of the fleet budget/TCO values (NOT part of the frozen profile-record contract in agent-bundle-contracts/). Validated by Helm at template time, so a malformed budgets map fails the Argo CD render loudly instead of producing a broken dashboard.

budgets.description: persona -> monthly USD budget. Persona keys must be DNS-label-shaped: they are spliced into PromQL profile="..." matchers and Grafana rule uids.

discordUrl.description: Retired input. Discord is roadmap-only; use webhookUrl.

hermes-alerting.description: Helm injects a key per subchart. hermes-alerting is a LIBRARY chart with no values of its own (#619); this entry exists only so the root's additionalProperties: false does not reject Helm's own injection.
